items.text: New England QB: Drake Maye (fractured fibula) DNP, out for weeks; Tommy DeVito starts.

New England (Wed/Thu practice): DNP - WR A.J. Brown (hamstring), CB Carlton Davis III (knee), OL Walter Rouse (concussion). LIMITED - WR Romeo Doubs and G Alijah Vera-Tucker (both returning from IR). IR - RB TreVeyon Henderson.
LA Chargers QB (uncertain): Justin Herbert (concussion protocol) DNP Wed and Thu, 'remains in doubt'; D.J. Uiagalelei likely starts if he sits, Jake Browning promoted. Friday report decides.

LA Chargers (Wed/Thu practice): DNP both days - RB Keaton Mitchell, WR Brenen Thompson, TE David Njoku, DT Dalvin Tomlinson, EDGE Tuli Tuipulotu, EDGE Akheem Mesidor, LB Daiyan Henley, CB Tarheeb Still.

adjust.reason: The Chargers had eight non-QB starters and contributors miss both practices, including DT Tomlinson, EDGEs Tuipulotu and Mesidor, LB Henley, CB Still and TE Njoku, while New England gets Doubs and Vera-Tucker back against losing Brown and Davis.
